bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to education finance; adjusting the special education initial aid amount for Independent School District No. 709, Duluth; creating a supplemental special education aid for Independent School District No. 709, Duluth; appropriating money.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. SPECIAL EDUCATION INITIAL AID ADJUSTMENT; DULUTH.

(a) For fiscal year 2026 and later, special education initial aid for Independent School District No. 709, Duluth, must be increased each year by $500,000 to reflect changes not included when the 2016 special education base was established.

(b) Each year, the Department of Education must add the amount in paragraph (a) to the special education initial aid computed under Minnesota Statutes, section 125A.76, subdivision 2a, for Independent School District No. 709, Duluth.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective for special education aid for fiscal year 2026 and later.

Sec. 2. APPROPRIATION; SPECIAL EDUCATION.

Subdivision 1.

Department of Education.

The sums indicated in this section are appropriated from the general fund to the Department of Education in the fiscal years designated.

Special education base adjustment.
